classes.label: Credential Broker
classes.def: Issues the identity an agent acts under.

classes.label: Execution Context
classes.def: Sandbox, runtime permissions and resource limits for a run.

classes.label: Guardrail / Policy Engine
classes.def: Evaluates each proposed action against policy before it runs.

classes.label: Business Outcome Harness
classes.def: Legitimate completion, prohibited outcomes, cost and the business constraints an agent must respect.

classes.label: Human Approval Gate
classes.def: Human decision point inserted into the agent loop.

classes.label: MCP / API Connector
classes.def: Transport that exposes enterprise systems to the agent.

classes.label: Long-term Memory
classes.def: Persisted state reused across runs — a poisoning target.

classes.label: Short-term Memory
classes.def: Working context carried across steps of one run.

classes.label: Planner / Reasoner
classes.def: Decomposes a goal into steps and chooses the next action.

classes.label: Retriever / RAG Index
classes.def: Vector or keyword index feeding untrusted content into context.

classes.label: Sub-agent Delegation
classes.def: Agent-to-agent hand-off; authority travels with the call.

classes.label: Tool Registry
classes.def: Declared tools, their scopes and their side effects.

classes.label: Trace & Telemetry
classes.def: Observed steps, tool calls and decisions — the evidence base.
